不计分的优先事项与取舍

description.en: Preferred settings and routines, with limited style signals
description.zh-CN: 偏好的工作场景与安排，仅提供少量工作风格信号

description.en: Exploration goals and preferred next steps
description.zh-CN: 探索目标和偏好的后续步骤

criteria.en: Open with broad questions, cover all seven categories, then fill remaining slots with a mix of relevant and unfamiliar contexts. Keep within the existing 18-answer limit. Do not use unanswered items, logistical preferences, language, or self-reported confidence to exclude fields.
criteria.zh-CN: 以广泛的问题开场，覆盖全部七类，再用相关与陌生情境相结合的问题补足。遵守现有最多十八题的限制。不得根据未作答的题目、工作安排偏好、使用语言或自我报告的信心排除职业领域。

criteria.en: Count field coverage across the choices shown, not only the choices selected. Include opportunities outside the strongest current field signal.
criteria.zh-CN: 按展示的选项统计领域覆盖度，不只看已选答案。给当前得分最高的领域之外的选项留出机会。

criteria.en: An interdisciplinary item offers at least one choice with two career field weights. Include at least two such items before filling adaptive slots.
criteria.zh-CN: 跨学科题目至少有一个选项对应两个职业领域。先纳入至少两道此类题目，再补充自适应选题。

criteria.en: Within a category, optionally use focus tag overlap as a tie-breaker. Avoid two questions with nearly the same scenario or tradeoff, keep IDs stable, and keep the custom choice last if shuffling other choices.
criteria.zh-CN: 同一类别内可用关注标签的重合度作为排序依据。避免选入场景或取舍过于相似的问题；保持标识符稳定，打乱其他选项时把自定义选项留在最后。

criteria.en: Use the same question IDs, option IDs, and scoring maps in either language. The engine must register this bank before accepting answers with these IDs.
criteria.zh-CN: 两种语言使用相同的题目标识、选项标识与计分映射。引擎须先注册本题库，才能接受这些标识对应的作答。

weights.en: Option weights add to the existing tag totals. Abilities use at most one point as a self-report signal. Scores indicate exploration preferences, never proficiency.
weights.zh-CN: 选项权重累加到现有标签分值。能力题作为自我报告信号，最多加一分。分值用于探索偏好，不代表熟练程度。

fieldWeights.en: Use existing catalog field labels. Field points require a field-relevant activity. The current engine multiplies field points by eight, so use them sparingly and keep other fields eligible. A single response does not identify a career.
fieldWeights.zh-CN: 使用现有目录中的职业领域名称。只为明确涉及相关领域的活动赋分。当前引擎会将领域分值乘以八，因此应谨慎使用，并保留探索其他领域的机会。单个回答不能确定职业。

unscored.en: Empty mappings capture context for reflection. In particular, stability, income, access, and scheduling preferences should not contribute to trait or field scores.
unscored.zh-CN: 空映射记录用于反思的背景信息。尤其不应把稳定性、收入、可及条件和日程偏好纳入特质或领域计分。

prompt.en: Describe what fits you, or say that you are unsure or prefer not to answer.
prompt.zh-CN: 可以描述更符合你的情况，也可以说明尚不确定或不想回答。

handling.en: Treat notes as optional context. If notes must remain unscored, omit them when calling the current score collector. Its built-in note matcher recognizes only English keywords, so do not use it for bilingual scoring parity.
handling.zh-CN: 将备注视为可选背景。如果备注必须不计分，调用当前计分函数时应省略备注。内置备注匹配器仅识别英语关键词，因此不应用于需要中英双语计分一致的场景。
